caseName: Kilpatrick v. Texas & Pacific Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Kilpatrick v. Texas & Pacific Railway Co. Parker v. Texas & Pacific Railway Co. Ex parte Kilpatrick and Ex parte Parker
attorneys: William H. DeParcq for petitioners., John M. Scott and William H. Timbers for respondent.

opinions.text: In Nos. 275 and 276 the petition for writs of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit- is denied. In Nos. 119, Misc. and 120, Misc., the motion for leave to file petition for writs of prohibition is denied.
